title: Agent Mesh V2 Flow Pipeline Schema
description: YAML-based Pipeline definition for 'am run'. Matches internal/engine/types.go Pipeline struct.

name.description: Pipeline identifier. Defaults to the YAML filename if omitted.

default_backend.description: Default backend tier for all LLM steps. Must be a standard tier for portability across environments. Users customize tier resolution via tier_routing in their local config.yaml.

contract.description: Non-executable intent declaration: why this flow exists, what output is expected, and what success looks like.

imports.description: External resources (e.g. shared profile files) to merge into this pipeline.

parameters.description: Input arguments for the pipeline. Prompted in interactive mode, use --param in batch mode.

profiles.description: Named reusable LLM settings (persona, backend/agent, temperature). Steps reference profiles by name.

default_profile.description: Profile name applied to all steps that don't specify their own profile.

interactive.description: Interactive-mode behavior configuration. Ignored in batch mode (-y).

shell_policy.description: Execution restrictions for shell commands in this pipeline.

pipeline_role.description: Restricts which step types the pipeline may contain. orchestrator: pipeline/shell/context only (no LLM). worker/analyzer: llm/shell/context only (no run_pipeline). handler: invoked by state machine engine, same constraints as worker. Defaults to worker if omitted.

mcp_config.description: Default MCP configuration for all LLM steps. File path or profile name from .agent-mesh/mcp-profiles/. Step-level claude_code.mcp_config overrides this.

steps.description: Ordered list of steps to execute sequentially.

FlowContract.description: Non-executable intent contract: answers why the flow exists, what output is expected, and what success looks like.

goal.description: One-line statement of why this flow exists and what problem it solves.

expected_results.description: Observable outcomes that should be produced when the flow succeeds.

success_criteria.description: Conditions that must hold true for the output to be considered acceptable.

Step.description: A single unit of work: gather context → call LLM/tool → execute action.

id.description: Unique step identifier within the pipeline.

type.description: Execution category. Determines which fields are valid: shell (requires action), llm (requires instruction/profile), pipeline (requires run_pipeline), context (requires context map), file (requires file config), apply (requires apply config), frontmatter (requires frontmatter config), move (requires src/dest_dir), read_file (requires src), worktree (requires worktree config).

backend.description: LLM backend target. Can be a tier ('fast'), provider ('groq'), named target ('anthropic/smart'), or a list for inline fallback.

agent.description: Agent tool target. Stateful CLI tool with file/shell access (e.g. 'claude', 'gemini', 'aider'). Can be a string or list for fallback.

profile.description: Named profile from the pipeline's 'profiles' map. Fills in empty step fields (backend, agent, role, system_prompt, temperature).

depends_on.description: Step IDs whose context/output this step inherits.

context.description: Map of key → shell command. Output stored as {{id.key}} in the state map.

system_prompt.description: Core persona and rules. Can be literal text or a filename (e.g. 'code-reviewer.md') from .agent-mesh/prompts/ or ~/.agent-mesh/prompts/.

role.description: Specific identity (e.g. 'You are a Senior SRE'). Prepended to system_prompt.

instruction.description: The actual user task/prompt. Supports interpolation: {{step_id.key}}, {{output}}, {{param.name}}.

action.description: Shell command to run after the LLM responds. Use {{output}} to inject the LLM result.

exit_if_empty.description: If the named context key is empty after gathering, the entire pipeline exits successfully.

when.description: Condition expression. Step is skipped if evaluation is false. Example: '{{prev.status}} == true'.

ignore_error.description: If true, pipeline continues even if this step fails (overrides fail-fast).

json_mode.description: Force LLM to output valid JSON. Not all models support this.

cwd.description: Working directory for all shell commands in this step.

timeout_seconds.description: Time limit for LLM or shell commands in this step.

loop.description: Foreach iteration config. Used with run_pipeline for batch processing.

parallel.description: When true and run_pipeline is set, sub-pipelines run concurrently via goroutines.

run_pipeline.description: Delegate to another pipeline YAML by name. Cannot be mixed with action or instruction.

pipeline_params.description: Explicit parameters to pass to the sub-pipeline. Values support interpolation (e.g. '{{loop.file}}'). Overrides inherited parent params.

claude_code.description: Claude Code CLI flags. Only valid when agent resolves to 'claude'.

gemini.description: Gemini CLI flags. Only valid when agent resolves to 'gemini'.

file.description: File operation config. Required for type: file.

apply.description: Apply LLM output as file changes. Required for type: apply.

src.description: Source file path. Required for type: move and type: read_file. Supports interpolation.

dest_dir.description: Destination directory. Required for type: move. Relative paths resolve from scope root (parent of src's parent).

frontmatter.description: Frontmatter manipulation config. Required for type: frontmatter.

worktree.description: Git worktree lifecycle config. Required for type: worktree.

on_error.description: Cleanup actions to run if this step fails. Supports frontmatter and move sub-actions.

LoopConfig.description: Foreach iteration over a list of items.

items.description: JSON array or newline-delimited list to iterate over. Supports interpolation.

item_var.description: Variable name for the current item. Access via {{loop.<item_var>}}.

index_var.description: Variable name for the current index.

max_iterations.description: Safety cap to prevent runaway loops.

Parameter.description: Input argument. Prompted in interactive mode; defaults or errors in batch.

name.description: Parameter name. Referenced as {{param.<name>}} in templates.

required.description: If true, errors in batch mode when unset.

description.description: Human-readable description. Shown as prompt text in interactive mode.

Profile.description: Reusable LLM settings. Steps reference by name; profile fields act as defaults.

backend.description: Default LLM backend for steps using this profile.

agent.description: Default agent tool for steps using this profile.

system_prompt.description: Default system prompt. Can be a file reference.

ImportConfig.description: External resources to merge into the pipeline.

profiles.description: List of external profile files to import. Can be plain strings or objects with path/as.

oneOf.description: Relative path or name of the profile file (without .yaml extension).

path.description: File path (relative to pipeline YAML or searched in .agent-mesh/profiles/).

as.description: Explicit namespace alias. Default: base filename.

Interactive.description: Interactive-mode behavior. All fields are ignored in batch mode (-y).

prompt.description: Map of parameter name → human-readable prompt text.

confirm_before.description: Step IDs that require user confirmation before execution.

auto_decide.description: Step IDs whose LLM output should be reviewed by the user.

ShellPolicy.description: Execution restrictions for shell commands. Supports allowlist, blocklist, or unrestricted modes.

mode.description: Enforcement strategy. allowlist: only Allow commands permitted. blocklist: Deny commands blocked. unrestricted: no restrictions (default).

inherit.description: Whether to merge the global sandbox config. Set false to ignore global config entirely.

allow.description: Command names permitted for execution (used in allowlist mode).

deny.description: Command names blocked from execution (used in blocklist mode).

deny_patterns.description: Regex patterns matched against the full command string. Applies in both allowlist and blocklist modes.

FileConfig.description: Configuration for type: file steps. Deterministic file operations.

path.description: Target file/directory path. Required for read, write, edit, delete, mkdir.

from.description: Source path. Required for move, copy.

to.description: Destination path. Required for move, copy.

content.description: Content to write. Required for write.

ApplyConfig.description: Configuration for type: apply steps. Bridges LLM output to file modifications.

format.description: How to parse LLM output. search-replace: <<<SEARCH/>>>REPLACE blocks. full-file: entire content replacement.

source.description: LLM output to parse. Supports interpolation (e.g. '{{implement.output}}').

target.description: Default target file path. Can be overridden per block in search-replace format.

FrontmatterStepConfig.description: Configuration for type: frontmatter steps. Reads YAML frontmatter, applies mutations, writes back.

file.description: Path to the file whose frontmatter will be modified. Supports interpolation.

set.description: Key-value pairs to set in the frontmatter. Values support interpolation and are auto-typed (int/bool/string).

increment.description: Keys to increment by the given delta. Creates the key with delta value if missing.

remove.description: Keys to remove from the frontmatter.

append.description: Maps field names to values (primitives or objects) to append to the list. Truncates history to 20 items.

OnErrorConfig.description: Cleanup actions executed when a step fails. Runs in isolated state with {{error.message}} available.

frontmatter.description: Frontmatter mutation to apply on error (e.g. record error timestamp).

move.description: Move action to execute on error (e.g. move task to error queue).

ClaudeCodeConfig.description: Claude Code CLI flags for tool-based LLM execution. Maps to internal/engine/types.go ClaudeCodeConfig.

lightweight.description: Run in lightweight mode (--disable-slash-commands, --strict-mcp-config, default setting_sources=project).

mcp_config.description: Path to MCP configuration file or profile name.

fallback_model.description: Fallback model if primary is unavailable.

tools.description: Explicit tool type allowlist (e.g. [Read, Edit, Bash]).

allowed_tools.description: Tool glob patterns that bypass approval (--allowedTools).

work_dir.description: Working directory for the Claude CLI process.

add_dirs.description: Additional directories to add to the workspace (--add-dir).

backend.description: API backend. 'anthropic' (default) or 'zai' (Z.AI proxy, requires ZAI_API_KEY).

fallback_backend.description: Retry backend on quota/auth errors from primary.

experimental_agent_teams.description: Enable Claude Code multi-agent team orchestration.

GeminiConfig.description: Gemini CLI flags for tool-based LLM execution.

include_dirs.description: Additional directories to include in workspace context.

work_dir.description: Working directory for the Gemini CLI process.

WorktreeConfig.description: Git worktree lifecycle configuration for type: worktree steps.

action.description: Lifecycle operation. open: create worktree + branch. close: merge back + cleanup.

branch.description: New branch name (open only). Supports interpolation.

base.description: Base ref to branch from (open only). Defaults to HEAD.

merge.description: Whether to merge the worktree branch back on close.

strategy.description: Merge strategy. squash: single commit. rebase: linear. merge: standard.
